outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented tomographic reconstruction (surface rendering) of the apical end of a sporozoite, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented tomographic reconstruction of the basal end of a sporozoite, not a plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing filaments highlighted in green, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D is a schematic/3D model rendering of a lateral section showing actin populations, not a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume shown as a micrograph-like image, not a bar/line/summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament-density interaction, not a plot; the N=2 label refers to observation count, not a summary statistic plot.
